_comment: Shared adversarial redaction fixtures. Loaded by BOTH server/tests/test_redaction_e2e.py (Python redact.redact) and client/redact_fixtures_test.go (Go redactReport). Both must agree on every case -> client (Go) and server (Python) redactors are byte-parity mirrors. Every expectation was hand-verified against server/analyzer/redact.py (spec: docs/redaction.md). must_redact = substrings that MUST be ABSENT from the redacted output; must_keep = substrings that MUST REMAIN; labels = the EXACT set of labels that must have fired (over- AND under-redaction fail). NOTE: the credential regex has NO leading \b, so underscore-glued config keys like `aws_secret_access_key=...` ARE redacted (see aws-secret-glued case); the trailing \b still blocks mid-word hits (`Secretary:`). Secret tokens are redacted at EVERY mode (SECRETS patterns run unconditionally, before the level gate).
